judged_text: The only spec for the found-topic path mocks TopicView to return nil and no spec renders any embed view, so the feature's core acceptance criterion — which posts the embed actually shows — is never verified. The suite passes with @topic_view set to the mock's nil (best.html.erb:2 would NoMethodError on nil.posts if views rendered, and render_views is off), so TopicView's real handling of the {best: 5} option, the post selection, and the entire rendered output ship untested; a regression in any of them is invisible to CI.

adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the “topic_id is found” example sets `TopicView.expects(:new).with(123, nil, {best: 5})` but does not stub a return value, so Mocha will return `nil` by default. The controller assigns `@topic_view = TopicView.new(...)` and would then render `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, whose first conditional calls `@topic_view.posts.present?`—this would raise `NoMethodError` if views were rendered. Controller specs don’t render views by default (no `render_views` here), and there are no other specs rendering `embed/best` or `embed/loading`, so the embed page output and TopicView’s real behavior with `{best: 5}` are not actually exercised by CI.
